userStories.title: Delete the dead config selectors
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Delete the 13 unused config selector values and unused factory/types without changing retained selector behavior or live slice shapes.

**Motivation** — 13 selector values in `config/selectors.ts` have no production importer besides the `src/config/index.ts` barrel.

**Approach** — Part 1: selectors (US-001)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `config/selectors.ts` | the 13 dead selector values go |
| `config/selectors.ts` | `RectifyConfig`, `VerifyConfig`, `RectificationGateConfig`, `PromptLoaderConfig`, `MutationCheckConfig` and `ExecutionGatesConfig` go |
| `config/selectors.ts` | each of the eight live slice types is redefined as `Pick<NaxConfig, ...>` over the same section list its selector picked, for example `export type ReviewConfig = Pick<NaxConfig, "review" | "models" | "execution" | "project" | "quality" | "agent">;` |
| `config/selector.ts` | `reshapeSelector` is deleted; `pickSelector` and `ConfigSelector` stay; the header comment describes one factory |
| `config/index.ts` | the barrel exports of every deleted value and type go |

The redefined types keep their current shape, so no production consumer changes. A test that called a deleted selector to build a slice calls `pickSelector` with the same keys, or builds the `Pick` type directly. `RectificationGateConfig` has no importer. `rectificationGateConfigSelector` stays, and its picks do not change.

**Scope** — In: remove reviewConfigSelector, rectifyConfigSelector, verifyConfigSelector, mutationCheckConfigSelector, agentConfigSelector, interactionConfigSelector, precheckConfigSelector, executionGatesConfigSelector, testPatternConfigSelector, contextConfigSelector, contextToolRuntimeConfigSelector, promptLoaderConfigSelector and llmRoutingConfigSelector. Preserve ReviewConfig, AgentConfig, InteractionConfig, PrecheckConfig, TestPatternConfig, ContextConfig, ContextToolRuntimeConfig and LlmRoutingConfig as Pick aliases over the original key lists. Update slice-construction tests and pin retained selector key boundaries, including exclusion of non-selected sections. Out: US-002's runtime MutationCheckConfig interface and config-key/schema deletion; US-003's timeout/mode removal; US-004/US-005's maxIterations changes; narrowing live selector picks; changes to .nax rules or B4 documentation.

**Interface** — `export type ReviewConfig = Pick<NaxConfig, "review" | "models" | "execution" | "project" | "quality" | "agent">;`
Preserve `pickSelector` and `ConfigSelector`; do not introduce a replacement transform factory.

**Modification inventory** — Paths below are relative to packages/nax.
- src/config/selectors.ts — 13 dead selector values and six unused slice types go; eight live slice types become Pick aliases.
- src/config/selector.ts — reshapeSelector and its documentation go; header describes one factory.
- src/config/index.ts — remove deleted value/type/factory exports only.
- test/unit/config/selectors.test.ts — cases for deleted selectors go; agent-manager, quality, routing and plan cases stay; add/preserve the three retention ACs, including workflow selector keys.
- test/unit/config/selector.test.ts — reshapeSelector describe and import go.
- test/unit/config/mutation-check-schema.test.ts — selector describe and mutationCheckConfigSelector import go; do not delete the remaining schema tests until US-002.
- test/unit/acceptance/default-agent-acceptance.test.ts, test/unit/execution/lifecycle/default-agent-migration.test.ts, test/unit/tdd/default-agent-tdd.test.ts — agentConfigSelector calls become pickSelector("agent", "agent").
- test/unit/context/engine/query-feature-context-fragments.test.ts — use pickSelector with the same four sections.
- test/unit/context/engine/tool-runtime.test.ts — delete selector key-list test; replace other selector call with pickSelector over the same sections.
- test/unit/test-runners/resolver.test.ts — replace selector call with pickSelector; delete selector key-list test.
- test/unit/precheck/precheck-config-slice-widening.test.ts — rewrite as a PrecheckConfig type assertion, without a selector call.
- scripts/baselines/complexity-baseline.json — regenerate.
- scripts/baselines/test-escape-hatches-baseline.json — lower totals carried by deleted tests.

**Verification — all steps run in packages/nax**
1. `bun run typecheck`. A removed key, field, parameter or export that is still referenced fails here, including in test fixtures that build a `NaxConfig` literal.
2. A string sweep:
   - for each removed key, `rg -n -w '<leaf>' src bin scripts test`;
   - for each removed function, constant, type and file, `rg -n -w '<name>' src bin scripts test`.
   Sweep names: `reviewConfigSelector`, `rectifyConfigSelector`, `verifyConfigSelector`, `mutationCheckConfigSelector`, `agentConfigSelector`, `interactionConfigSelector`, `precheckConfigSelector`, `executionGatesConfigSelector`, `testPatternConfigSelector`, `contextConfigSelector`, `contextToolRuntimeConfigSelector`, `promptLoaderConfigSelector`, `llmRoutingConfigSelector`, `reshapeSelector`, `RectifyConfig`, `VerifyConfig`, `RectificationGateConfig`, `PromptLoaderConfig`, `ExecutionGatesConfig`.
   Expected remaining hits: none. `MutationCheckConfig` is not swept here, because `config/runtime-types-execution.ts` has its own interface of that name and US-002 removes it.
   Expected result: only the remaining hits the story lists, else stop. A hit in code is a missed reference. A hit in a comment is a stale comment and is reworded, in any file. A comment edit needs no Modifies entry. A hit that names a different concept with the same word is listed in the story, not changed. Line numbers are at `fc24a6805`. A story that runs after another story edited the same file locates each site by its symbol.
3. `bun run check:complexity:update`, and `bun run check:file-sizes -- --update-baseline` when that check reports a lowerable entry. After `check:all` is green, `bun run check:test-escape-hatches:update` lowers the escape-hatch totals the deleted tests carried.
4. `bun run check:all` and `bun run test`.

A trimmed source file also drops the imports only its removed code used; biome's `noUnusedImports` reports them. A test that only exercises a removed key, selector or method is deleted. A test that mixes removed and kept behaviour is trimmed, so the kept assertions stay. A fixture that sets a removed key drops that key. The three original spec ACs and the explicit non-selected-key exclusion criterion are retention pins that already pass, not new fail-first gaps.

userStories.title: Add removed-key stripping and remove dead rectification and execution sections
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Introduce a shared immutable warn-and-strip module and remove eleven unused rectification leaves, flakeDetection, mutationCheck and commandInterceptor.provider.

**Motivation** — Only `maxAttemptsTotal` (`execution/story-selector.ts:42`, `unified-executor-dispatch-phases.ts:198`) and `fullSuiteTimeoutSeconds` (`quality/gate-timeout.ts:29`) are read.

**Approach** — Part 2: the removed-key strip, the rectification keys and three dead execution sections (US-002)

A new module `src/config/removed-config-keys.ts`. `config-guards.ts` is at 592 of its 600 allowed lines.

**Interface**
```typescript
/** Hint for a key that only configured the removed pipeline mode. */
export const PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT = "nothing reads this key since pipeline mode was removed";

/** Config keys removed in C1, each with the hint its warning appends. */
export const REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;

/** Strip each dotted path in `keys` from `conf`, warning once per path present:
 *  `Config key "<path>" has been removed — <hint>. Remove it from your config.`
 *  Tolerates missing and non-object intermediates. Returns a new object; never mutates `conf`. */
export function stripKeysAtPaths(
  conf: Record<string, unknown>,
  keys: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
  warn?: (msg: string) => void,
): Record<string, unknown>;

/** stripKeysAtPaths(conf, REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS, warn). */
export function stripRemovedConfigKeys(
  conf: Record<string, unknown>,
  warn?: (msg: string) => void,
): Record<string, unknown>;
```

- The path walk and `rebuildAtPath` move out of `config-guards.ts` (`:319-377`), and `stripRemovedNoOpKeys` becomes a one-line call to `stripKeysAtPaths(conf, REMOVED_NO_OP_KEYS, warn)`. Its warning text and behaviour are unchanged: it still returns a new top-level object when no key matched. Its doc comment stays with it.
- `stripRemovedConfig` (`config/removed-stage-names.ts`) runs `stripRemovedNoOpKeys`, then `stripRemovedConfigKeys`, then `stripRemovedStageNames`, with one sink. `loader.ts` already calls `stripRemovedConfig` at all three strip sites (`:256`, `:533`, `:569`), so `loader.ts` does not change. The strip runs before `NaxConfigSchema.safeParse` at each site, so a key under a `.strict()` schema such as `CommandInterceptorConfigSchema` is gone before the schema sees it.

US-002 then removes these keys and adds each to `REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS`. The rectification leaves, `flakeDetection` and `mutationCheck` get `PIPELINE_ONLY_KEY_HINT`. `execution.commandInterceptor.provider` gets `nothing read this key; the interceptor is always rtk`, because it was never read, even in pipeline mode:

|:---|:---|
| `execution.rectification.{enabled, maxAttemptsPerStrategy, maxFailureSummaryChars, abortOnIncreasingFailures, consecutiveIncreasesToBail, abortOnNoProgress, consecutiveNoProgressToBail, storyScopedFixBudget, rethinkAtAttempt, urgencyAtAttempt, repoScopedFallback}` | `RectificationConfigSchema` (`schemas-execution.ts:62-105`); `RectificationConfig` (`runtime-types.ts:55-83`) keeps `maxAttemptsTotal` and `fullSuiteTimeoutSeconds`; descriptions (`cli/config-descriptions.ts:133-149`) |
| (same) | `RectifierPromptBuilder.continuation` (`rectifier-builder.ts:234-277`) and `.escalated` (`:503-530`) are deleted with the imports only they used |
| `execution.flakeDetection` (section) | `FlakeDetectionConfigSchema` (`schemas-execution.ts:165-176`) and its field (`:342-347`); `FlakeDetectionConfig` (`runtime-types-execution.ts`); default (`schemas.ts:193`); merge (`merge.ts:137-140`); descriptions |
| `execution.mutationCheck` (section) | its schema (`schemas-execution.ts:178-190`) and field (`:348-352`); `MutationCheckConfig` (`runtime-types-execution.ts`); default (`schemas.ts:199`); merge (`merge.ts:141-144`); descriptions (`config-descriptions.ts:154-160`) |
| `execution.commandInterceptor.provider` | its schema field (`schemas-execution.ts:228`); the `provider` field (`runtime-types-execution.ts:86`); the default `provider: "rtk"` (`schemas-execution.ts:354`) |

Also in US-002, `rejectLegacyRectificationKeys` (`config-guards.ts:81-153`) still rejects `quality.autofix.rethinkAtAttempt` and `.urgencyAtAttempt`. Their hints become the lines: - Remove `quality.autofix.rethinkAtAttempt` and - Remove `quality.autofix.urgencyAtAttempt`, in place of the old - Move ... → `execution.rectification.*` lines. Its other three keys keep their hints.

**Timing constraint.** `loadConfig` starts from `structuredClone(DEFAULT_CONFIG)` (`config/loader.ts`), and `DEFAULT_CONFIG` is `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`. If a key is added to the strip list while the schema still defaults it, every load warns. So a story adds a key to `REMOVED_CONFIG_KEYS` in the same change that removes the key's schema field and default.

**Scope** — In: create the shared traversal and compatibility map; wire it through the existing composition; remove the listed schema/default/type/description/merge surfaces and the two uncalled builder methods; retain all kept behavior. Warn once for each removed whole section, not once per leaf under it. Out: US-003's verificationTimeoutSeconds/regressionGate.mode entries; US-004/US-005's maxIterations work; US-001's already-deleted selectors; acceptance, worktree isolation, other tdd/autoMode/quality/prompts/optimizer keys, permission vocabulary and B4 documentation.
